en.title: Renewing: can you still travel?

root.heading: Is the passport still in your hands?

branches.heading: Travel on it while it stays valid
Surrendered: you wait for the new one

en.focal: No country lets you fly internationally without a passport in hand
en.alt: Hand-drawn decision tree: is the passport still in your hands? Yes - travel on it while it stays valid (US mail-in renewal, UK digital renewal). No - surrendered, you wait for the new one (UK postal renewal, Australia, Canada). No country lets you fly internationally without a passport in hand
en.caption: One question decides everything: whether your old passport is still in your possession.
